title: Exponential time constructibility
statement: The function $T(n)=2^n$ is time constructible: for every $n$, $n\le 2^n$, and some positive integer constant $a$ and finite binary Turing machine compute, on every binary input $x$, the little-endian binary representation of $2^{|x|}$ within $a(2^{|x|}+1)$ steps.
